notes.range_nmi: The commonly quoted AIM-120 'pitbull' acquisition range. No primary source found; see docs/REFERENCE.md 8.3.
notes.rcs_m2: The reference target, no aspect factor: the same convention as the aircraft radar's fit. Against the F-16 type's own RCS shape estimate the per-look coin flip is at 9.3 nmi nose-on (3.78 m2), 15.0 nmi beam-on (25.4 m2).
notes.reference_fluctuation: The reference target fluctuates as Swerling 1, like the F-16 type: the cited range is read as the range at which ONE look detects it with probability 0.5.
